layering.description: One-way layering preserved (backend/tests/architecture): domain/risk.py and domain screening code import nothing from services, repositories, controllers or sqlalchemy.

typing.description: From backend/: `.venv/Scripts/python -m ruff check .`, `.venv/Scripts/python -m mypy src/` and `.venv/Scripts/python -m pytest` exit 0; no skipped or xfail test mapped to this sprint's features.

migrations.description: Published rule sets are immutable at DB level: a raw UPDATE or DELETE of a published rule_sets row is blocked by trigger (F089); watchlist seed (5 AML + 5 PEP) comes from an alembic migration (F081); screening results are append-only (F082). Verified by pytest.
